name: Shrine of Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts
desc:
**The Shrine of Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts** is a shrine dedicated to the Drowned God [Yun'Shul, Keeper of Hearts](entity:yunshul_keeper_of_hearts). It allows the player to use wishes to grant

The shrine also acts as the penultimate step of obtaining the Contractor Oath; choosing the "What happened to this place?" dialogue option will enable the dialogue with [The Lord Regent](entity:the_lord_regent) offering to join him.

Speaking with Yun'Shul will show another dialogue for getting the Soulbreaker Oath after meeting all requirements, the second to last step.

It's possible to interact with the shrine at range using the Idol of Yun'Shul. This will allow for one wish to be made and consume the item after usage. The item doesn't require a Resonance and will consume your wish if you have it; though, it can still be used without a wish - to get the most mileage out of it, you should be unable to obtain a wish from Yun'Shul's _shrine_ itself by the time you use it.
additional_info:
-   Originally, only Oathless could be removed, and it had differing dialogue: _"The Vow I made to never take up an Oath no longer matches my ambitions. I wish for a new path."_
-   The maximum amount of Wishes a player can carry at any given time is 197. You can purchase Wishes from Misérables, however the price ramps up, costing 15 Knowledge initially with every stacking Wish costing the previous price + 5 Knowledge (e.g. 15 -> 20 -> 25 -> 30, stacking a mere 4 wishes has cost you a total of 90 Knowledge). Wish 197 costs 995 Knowledge, making 198 Wishes not possible, as it'd require you to go past the Knowledge cap.
    -   This would require a combined total of ~99,485 Knowledge.
-   [Yun'Shul](entity:yunshul_keeper_of_hearts) is one of three confirmed Drowned Gods so far, along with [Korilfiend](entity:korilfiend_the_infernos_provenance), the Drowned God of Fire, and [Ethiron](entity:ethiron_the_maelstroms_eye), the Drowned God of Sky and Pressure.
-   There is an Enchantment named after Yun'Shul, the Curse of Yun'Shul.
-   Oathbreaking while having equipped an weapon that you dont have requirements of will result on that weapon being unequiped and automatically being swapped by a Sword even if you don't have it on your inventory.
